name: Historic Centre of Morelia
description: Morelia's historic centre sits on a hillside in the Guayangareo Valley, in Mexico's Michoacán state. Founded in the 1540s as Valladolid, it still follows its original street plan. More than 200 buildings in warm pink stone line the streets, mixing medieval, Renaissance, Baroque and neoclassical styles. The city was renamed for independence hero José María Morelos, who was born here.
